v1.35 hls.js 本地资源与来源记录 / Vendored asset and provenance record
===========================================================

Project version: v1.35. Commands, paths and verification values below are shared
by both languages. Dated validation records are preserved from that verification;
this documentation review does not claim a new runtime test or attestation run.

Version:
  hls.js v1.7.3

Upstream:
  https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases/tag/v1.7.3
  Git tag: v1.7.3
  Git commit: e5ff3583965e3af16c4a4b4d2b5f7bd1ffb5b7de
  npm package: hls.js@1.7.3
  Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/hls.js/-/hls.js-1.7.3.tgz

Runtime asset:
  web/hls.min.js

npm verification (Windows, 2026-09-12):
  dist.integrity:
  sha512-MsPlx6yVW4Qv4C7mEVou4/gk/5cN2dVxOTnrNjPSmyH2f0Ln+/UkG10Ax1PE6OvrmTVPKgQYozTtBaPOuCzq7A==

  dist.shasum:
  79a3338dd2e78fe63fc2ba6cfebdf5e34495537a

  Isolated npm 11.6.2 audit signatures verified 1 registry signature and 1
  provenance attestation. npm install --ignore-scripts --omit=dev reported
  zero vulnerabilities in the isolated hls.js@1.7.3 installation. The package
  has no runtime dependencies. Published tarball SHA-512/SHA-1 and extracted
  asset identity are verified. No npm installation is needed at runtime.

Runtime asset SHA-256:
  a12e7ee1cd64a69dcdb314157e45dafcba705bfb0b1440b7935cb265d374423e

Project use:
  appendTimeout, liveMaxUnchangedPlaylistRefresh, ResetMediaSource recovery
  and bufferAppendNoProgress handling remain enabled. Version 1.7.3 adds
  the upstream live-playlist synchronous-loader recursion guard and includes
  the fix for blocking reload at MSN 0. Existing single-rendition,
  weak-network and WHEP-first AUTO behavior is retained. No startup network
  fetch is required. start.sh checks this version marker and the fixed
  SHA-256 before launching the media stack.

Validation scope:
  The vendored asset is the unmodified published npm dist/hls.min.js.
  Project JavaScript regressions exercise the actual 1.7.3 BufferController
  append-ownership extension and the weak-network/player lifecycle policy.
  See the accompanying upgrade report for complete runtime and release test
  results. Historical upstream lint/build/unit runs are not claimed as
  fresh 1.7.3 tests.

License:
  See HLSJS-LICENSE.txt, copied from the same published npm package.

Project controller extension:
  web/hls-weak-network-policy.js exports withAppendOwnership(Base).
  web/app.js supplies it through Hls.DefaultConfig.bufferController.
  This guards append-deadline lifetime using pinned 1.7.3 controller methods.
  Compatibility of the published src/controller/buffer-controller.ts methods
  was checked during the upgrade. The real-controller regression reproduces an idle abort
  with the raw controller and verifies completion, queue-head replacement,
  buffer replacement, error, destruction, and active-timeout ownership with
  the extension. Raw dist/hls.min.js is unchanged; future library updates
  must rerun the real-controller and browser AV1 continuity regressions.

中文说明（与上文共用上游地址、提交和完整校验值）
================================================

版本与来源：
  本项目版本为 v1.35，随包 hls.js 版本为 v1.7.3。上游发布页、Git 标签与提交、
  npm 包 hls.js@1.7.3 和 tarball 地址见上文。运行资源位于 web/hls.min.js。

npm 验证记录（Windows，2026-09-12）：
  上文 dist.integrity 是下载包的 SHA-512，dist.shasum 是其 SHA-1；
  Runtime asset SHA-256 是解压后实际运行资源的 SHA-256，三者不可混用。
  隔离的 npm 11.6.2 audit signatures 核验了 1 份注册表签名和 1 份来源证明。
  npm install --ignore-scripts --omit=dev 在隔离的 hls.js@1.7.3 安装中报告
  零漏洞；该包没有运行时依赖。已核验发布包 SHA-512/SHA-1 与解压资源一致性。
  运行时无需 npm 安装，也不需要启动时访问网络下载资源。

项目行为：
  appendTimeout、liveMaxUnchangedPlaylistRefresh、ResetMediaSource 恢复和
  bufferAppendNoProgress 处理保持启用。v1.7.3 包含实时播放列表同步加载器
  递归保护及 MSN 0 阻塞重载修复。现有单路编码、弱网和优先 WHEP 的 AUTO 行为
  保留。start.sh 在启动媒体服务前检查此版本标记和固定 SHA-256。

验证范围：
  随包资源是未修改的 npm dist/hls.min.js。项目 JavaScript 回归针对真实
  v1.7.3 BufferController 的追加归属扩展、弱网策略和播放器生命周期执行。
  完整运行时与发行验证见随附升级报告；历史上游 lint、构建和单元测试不当作
  本次 v1.7.3 的新验证，本次文档整理也不代表重新执行运行测试。

项目控制器扩展：
  web/hls-weak-network-policy.js 导出 withAppendOwnership(Base)，
  web/app.js 通过 Hls.DefaultConfig.bufferController 使用它；扩展利用固定的
  v1.7.3 控制器方法保护追加超时的归属。升级时已检查上游
  src/controller/buffer-controller.ts 方法兼容性。真实控制器回归先复现原始
  控制器的空闲中止，再验证扩展下的完成、队头替换、缓冲区替换、错误、销毁和
  活动超时归属。原始 dist/hls.min.js 未修改。后续库升级必须重新运行真实控制器
  回归和浏览器 AV1 连续播放回归。

许可证：
  HLSJS-LICENSE.txt 来自同一个 npm 发布包，法律文本保持原样。
